passive.name: Metal Cat Claws
passive.text: Increases **Physical DMG** by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The equipper's DMG increases by **25/31.5/38/44/50%** when hitting the enemy from behind.

passive.name: Metal Cat Claws
passive.text: Increases **Physical DMG** by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The equipper's DMG increases by **25/31.5/38/44/50%** when hitting the enemy from behind.

passive.name: String & Melody
passive.text: CRIT DMG increases by **50/57.5/65/72.5/80%**. When the equipper enters combat, or activates a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, they gain 1 stack of **Heartstring**. Each stack of **Heartstring** allows the equipper's **Chain Attack** and **Ultimate** to ignore **12.5/14.5/16.5/18.5/20%** of the target's **Fire RES**, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: Sprouting Core
passive.text: Increases CRIT Rate by **15/17/19/21/23%**. When the equipper deals DMG with a **Basic Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's **Electric DMG** by **12.5/14.5/16.5/18.5/20%**, up to 2 stacks. Each stack lasts 40s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Can trigger once per use of a skill. At 2 stacks, the wearer's **Basic Attack** and **Ultimate** DMG ignore **20/23/26/29/32%** of enemy DEF.

passive.name: Tranquil Blossom
passive.text: CRIT DMG is increased by **30/34.5/39/43.5/48%**. When the equipper lands a hit with a **Basic Attack**, **Special Attack**, or **Aftershock**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's CRIT DMG by an additional **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, stacking up to 3 times. The effect lasts for 30s, with each stack's duration calculated separately, and can only be triggered once per use of a skill. With all 3 stacks, the equipper's **Electric DMG** increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**.

passive.name: Knight's Combo
passive.text: Launching a **Dodge Counter** or **Quick Assist** increases the equipper's ATK by **12/13.8/15.6/17.4/19.2%** for 12s.

substatLine: CRIT RATE (Until 100%) >= CRIT DMG = ATK% > PEN = ATK
skillPriority: Dodge > Chain Attack > Special Attack > Basic Attack > Assist

entries.name: Basic Attack: Kitty Slash
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 slashes, dealing **Physical DMG**.
On the last hit, there is a 33.33% chance to repeat this hit 3 times.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Crimson Blade
entries.text:
Hold Basic Attack during the first 3 hits of Nekomata's **Basic Attack** to activate:
Slashes enemies in front and passes through them, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Upon activation, there is a 33.33% chance to repeat this attack 3 times.

entries.name: Dodge: Can't Touch Me-ow~
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Over Here!
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Phantom Claws
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Cat's Paw
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Desperate Defense
entries.text:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Shadow Strike
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Surprise Attack
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Super Surprise Attack!
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Unleashes a powerful falling slash that deals massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Claw Swipe
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Claw Smash
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Stealthy Paws
entries.text: When Nekomata's **Dodge Counter** or **Quick Assist** hits an enemy, her DMG increases by **60%** for 6s.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Catwalk
entries.text:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
After any character inflicts **Assault**, increases the DMG of Nekomata's next **EX Special Attack** by 35%, stacking up to 2 times.

entries.name: Bird Hunter
entries.text:
When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's **Physical RES**.
If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.

entries.name: Cat & Mouse
entries.text: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.

entries.name: Curious Left Tail
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Sharpen Claws
entries.text: When Nekomata uses her **EX Special Attack**, her CRIT Rate increases by 7% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times, with each stack's duration being calculated separately.

entries.name: Lucky Right Tail
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Predator Lineage
entries.text: When Nekomata launches a **Chain Attack** or uses her **Ultimate**, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.
